introPt: A visitor leaves an evening well: person by person, one specific thing, a real see-you.
cenario: Leaving a home at the end of an evening.

dialogo.pt: Leaving already? Stay a little longer.

dialogo.es: Ya me tengo que ir, pero qué rico estuvo.
dialogo.pt: I have to go, but it was lovely.

dialogo.es: El mole de tu mamá no se me va a olvidar.
dialogo.pt: I won't forget your mum's mole.
Take care. We will be seeing each other.

perguntas.pergunta: How should you say goodbye at a gathering?
opcoes: To the room as a whole
With a wave from the door
perguntas.explica: A hasty group wave is the most common visitor misfire.
You need not stay, but you must not sprint.

perguntas.pergunta: Why name a specific thing you enjoyed?
opcoes: Specific praise travels to people not in the room
perguntas.explica: Your mum's mole gets repeated; it was lovely does not.

perguntas.pergunta: What does aquí tienes tu casa mean in practice?
opcoes: A genuine offer of standing worth answering
A polite way to end talk
perguntas.explica: Answering in kind converts courtesy into relationship.

perguntas.pergunta: Which is the warmer sign-off with someone you like?
perguntas.explica: Hasta luego works everywhere; cuídate is warmer.
